groups.title: Sanitary Sewer Construction
groups.summary: We can install all sizes of sanitary lines from force mains to gravity flow lines, including PVC and fiberglass.
groups.intro: We can install all sizes of sanitary lines from force mains to gravity flow lines, including PVC and fiberglass. We can also manage lift station construction of stations ranging from four to 16 feet in diameter and depths of up to 50 feet.

about.title: About Ser Construction
text: With over 150 years of combined construction experience, our management team has successfully completed hundreds of civil construction projects, and our specialized field operation crews are organized to ensure efficiency and provide innovative construction solutions.

SER's unique ability to self-perform nearly 90% of its work leads to a diligent and steady progression of the project from start to finish, resulting in a significant value to SER's customers. While we work closely with strategic subcontract partners, we don't rely on others to get the project completed.

SER is proud of the strong relationships that it has built with each of its customers for over 20 years, which are the result of SER's solutions-driven approach. Our company culture promotes cooperation, innovation, and strategic partnering with our customers to achieve a cost-efficient and timely resolution to unforeseen issues.
